jobs_results.title: Android Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Quantion is a Business Digital Transformation services company born in 2015.

We have +120 professionals in application development, UX/UI and digital business transformation to build innovative solutions oriented to business results.

We combine our teams in cutting-edge technologies and digital deep experiences with the innovation ecosystem, to ensure that we can provide the best solution to face business challenges, from its concept to its implementation.

We are looking for a Senior Android Developer for an airline project.

The project focuses on improving the passenger experience throughout the entire journey. The projects we focus on are the main web portals, mobile apps (iOS and Android) and B2B platforms of the client. In addition, we are developing our own R&D solutions within the company initiatives.

We are focused on the continuous development of our software engineers and therefore you can expect:
• Experienced developers to learn from,
• Weekly dev talks... time for refactoring and improvements,
• Dev team has freedom to choose frameworks/libraries,
• Individual development plan with trainings,
• Possibility to go to conferences.

Our technology stack: Android Studio; Kotlin; RxJava and RxKotlin; Dagger; Retrofit; Jetpack libraries including Room, Navigation, DataStore; Firebase

Are you interested in joining a group of software enthusiasts, working in an international agile team setup, creating products that make the difference in the entire airline industry - then apply now!

What do we expect?
• Experience in Android Studio,
• Practical knowledge of design & UX patterns,
• Experience in workflow tools (Jira),
• Experience in Continuous Integration,
• Knowledge of asynchronous server communication (REST API),
• Interest in modern Android frameworks like Android Jetpack and knowledge of reactive programming principles (RxJava),
• Good English skills for daily communication,
• Enthusiasm, curiosity and creativity,
• Team spirit,
• Open mind and open communication,
• Solution-oriented work ethic,
• Motivation to bring yourself and the team a step further.

Our offering:

✨ Permanent contract

✨ 22 days of vacation

✨ 5 additional holidays for Christmas

✨ 4 additional holidays for Easter

✨ Flexible working time

✨ Flexible remuneration: Health insurance

✨ Hybrid work: 2 office days and 3 telework days

✨ Continuous working days in summer

✨ Travel opportunities

✨ An international working environment, atmosphere that stimulates development,

✨ Individual career path

Committed to equality, at Quantion we believe in diversity and inclusion. We defend equal opportunities without discriminating based on gender, age, religion or sexual orientation or any other aspect that could be considered exclusive

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Android - 100% remoto
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como Desarrollador/a Android Nativo, trabajando con Kotlin, Jetpack compose, Unit testing, y otras tecnologías punteras, en un entorno internacional, siendo parte de un equipo agile y rodeado de perfiles senior de primer nivel?

Desde Oxigent Technologies, estamos buscando Programadores/as Android para el Hub Digital del grupo de Retail de mayor tamaño en Europa, ubicado en Barcelona, y con posibilidad de trabajar 100% remoto.

Trabajarás con un equipo multidisciplinario, compuesto por desarrolladores, QA, UX/UI y un Product owner hacía un objetivo en común: desarrollar, lanzar, y mantener las aplicaciones nativas de la compañía dentro del team responsable del desarrollo de nuevas aplicaciones.

¿Qué ventajas tiene este proyecto?
• Proyecto a largo plazo.
• Ambiente de Start-up con la ventaja de formar parte de un Big Player consolidado, con 400.000+ empleados/as que no depende de rondas de financiación.
• Cultura de última tecnología, estructura... llana y libertad de creación del producto hasta que se pone en producción.
• Equipo de perfiles Sénior de primer nivel.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?
• Desarrollar aplicaciones móviles mantenibles y estables de acuerdo con las necesidades comerciales y los requisitos técnicos.
• Participar en revisiones periódicas de código y actividades de intercambio de conocimientos con tu equipo.
• Proponer nuevas arquitecturas, frameworks, soluciones para el proyecto móvil.
• Escribir, principalmente, pruebas unitarias, pero también pruebas de interfaz de usuario, de integración y end to end.

Para ello, ¿Qué necesitamos?
• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones nativas de Android con Kotlin
• Experiencia comprobada con Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack compose, MVVM, MVVP, MVA (Android View Model)
• Experiencia comprobada en Unit testing (Junit, Mockito...)
• Experiencia con buenas prácticas de programación: Clean code, Clean Architecture, Design Patterns, SOLID, Inyección de dependencias, programación reactiva...
• Imprescindible buenas habilidades comunicativas en Español e Inglés (B2+ / C1)

Y llegados a este punto… ¿qué te ofrecemos?
• Contratación indefinida a través de Oxigent.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (Hasta 50K).
• Horario flexible, jornada intensiva los viernes.
• 100% remoto si no vives en Barcelona; imprescindible vivir en España
• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.
• Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.
• ¡Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Junior Android Developer (relocation to Frankfurt)
jobs_results.company_name: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
jobs_results.description:
With over 5 million app users, the company has established its app as a leading platform for comparisons in Germany. The Android teams are continuously enhancing and evolving the app to provide the best user experience. The app stands as one of the crucial pillars of the company, rather than just a by-product.

The company is dedicated to nurturing talent passionate about native app development, offering a supportive environment for career growth. They emphasize continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and a collaborative team spirit. They are currently seeking a Junior Android Developer for their InsurTech division in Frankfurt.

Location: Frankfurt, Germany. Type of contract: Permanent, on-site.

Main tasks:
• Contribute to the global app architecture and collaborate on central cross-sectional functions.
• Design and implement new features for the Android app.
• Work closely with team members and product management.
• Actively participate in the app's design and development... process.

Requirements
• Ideal candidates possess a degree in computer science or a related field, or have completed IT specialist training for application development.
• Prior experience with Android Studio, Kotlin, and Jetpack Compose is advantageous.
• Strong teamwork skills, proactive attitude, and proficiency in English are essential.

Benefits
• Experience the Best of Both Worlds: Enjoying the benefits of an established online environment with a startup atmosphere, individuals can prioritize long-term planning while actively shaping processes.
• Developer Community: Joining a vibrant app community eagerly anticipating contributions, individuals can immerse themselves in regular meet-ups, code reviews, and onsite speakers within Frankfurt's tech hub, fostering growth and collaboration.
• Compensation Package: Benefiting from an attractive salary package, including vouchers, a Sodexo card with monthly credit, a subsidized pension plan, and full inflation compensation.
• Work-Life Balance: Embracing flexibility with options for mobile working/home office (3 days in-office, 2 days flexible).
• "Work From Anywhere": Taking advantage of up to 4 weeks of remote work per year, even from abroad.
• Workplace Comfort: Enjoying ergonomic workstations equipped with modern tools like MacBooks and additional screens, along with height-adjustable desks from day one.
• Team Culture: Immersing in a relaxed work environment and informal culture, individuals can partake in regular team events, drink-outs, and recreational activities like table tennis, PlayStation, and rooftop terrace gatherings with a scenic skyline view.
• Personal Development: Exploring a wide range of training opportunities and personalized career development support fosters professional growth.
• Perks: Indulging in free hot and cold beverages, various cereal options, regular lunches, and fresh fruit.
• Sustainable Mobility: Benefiting from a central location, individuals can enjoy convenient travel via public transport or bicycle, supported by a complimentary Germany ticket and company bicycle leasing assistance.

For additional details about this position, don't hesitate to get in touch via adjera@zerotoonesearch.com

We're happy to provide further details
